constraints: Canonical artifacts must use `schema_version: 2`, declare `artifact_type`, and include required core fields.
Canonical artifact migration is explicit; OutcomeGraph does not silently auto-upgrade legacy canonical artifacts.
Missing `schema_version`, `schema_version < 2`, mixed `.outcomegraph` schema versions, and `schema_version > 2` are documented fail-fast conditions.
Adapter manifests must use `schema_version: 2` and `interface_version: 1` for `worker`, `oracle`, `sandbox`, `store`, and `exporter`.
After any repair, schema checks must be rerun before treating the repository as migrated.
goal: Capture the OutcomeGraph v2 migration guide as a reusable contract for explicit artifact migration, adapter compatibility checks, mixed-version rejection, and the documented `.outcomegraph/materials.lock` blocker remediation.
scope: Document repository migration into OutcomeGraph artifact schema v2 and adapter policy requirements.
Capture preflight audit steps, explicit v1-to-v2 canonical artifact recreation, and post-migration validation checkpoints.
Preserve the documented `.outcomegraph/materials.lock` artifact_type mismatch, expected canonical shape, and repair intent.
